notes.kg: a cartridge's weight is the jet's
notes.motion: released at the jet's speed along its nose, a little down (toward a point 2 km ahead, 30 m below, in body axes), slowing at 150 m/s² to 5 m/s: the chaff bundle stops in the air within about 1.6 s and blooms 75 m behind the jet after 1 s at 250 m/s, its pieces falling (decoy_fx.gd). Until 2026-11-16 the decoy flew 200 m aft at |V| + 10 m/s and ended there in about 0.85 s, so from behind the jet no decoy was ever seen
